title: Final Trial
wikitext:
{{Infobox Dungeon |type= |image= {{Media |Screenshot BotW= File:BotW Final Trial.png |Map BotW= File:BotW DLC Final Trial Map.jpeg }} |caption= |location= [[Shrine of Resurrection]] |game= BotW |other= |item= |quest= [[Master Cycle Zero]] |mini-boss= |boss= [[Monk Maz Koshia]] |theme= |strategy= }} The {{Term/Store|Final Trial||Series, BotW}} is a challenge and [[Dungeon]] in {{TCB}} [[Downloadable Content]] Pack for {{BotW}}.{{Fact}} It takes place inside what seems to be an unnamed [[Divine Beast]]. The design of the [[Dungeon]] resembles an engine, suggesting a connection to the [[Master Cycle Zero]], the [[Item]] received when completing this trial. ==Entrance to the Trial== The Final Trial can only be accessed after [[Link]] has completed "[[EX Champion Urbosa's Song]]," "[[EX Champion Daruk's Song]]," "[[EX Champion Mipha's Song]]," and "[[EX Champion Revali's Song]]." Once he has done so, he will hear the voice of [[Monk Maz Koshia]], who instructs him to return to the [[Shrine of Resurrection]] for the Final Trial.{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Monk Blue|I am Maz Koshia. I must commend you for conquering the trial thus far. The door to the final trial is now open at the Shrine of Resurrection. Go, and face your destiny.}}|Monk Maz Koshia|BotW}} Inside the Shrine of Resurrection, Link once again hears the voice of Monk Maz Koshia.{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Monk Blue|To the brace soul who wishes to master a Divine Beast... You have done well to return to this place of beginnings. You have overcome many challenges. Now, allow me to bestow upon you one final trial.}}|Monk Maz Koshia|BotW}} He tells Link to return the [[Sheikah Slate]] to the [[Sheikah Slate Terminal]] he obtained it from,{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Monk Blue|Return the Sheikah Slate to the terminal you first obtained it from. Do so, and the final passageway will reveal itself.}}|Monk Maz Koshia|BotW}} which seals the door to the chamber and causes it do descend into the Dungeon.{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Monk Blue|Descending...
Please beware of tremors.}}|Sheikah Slate Terminal|BotW}} The door opens before the descent is complete, however, a magical barrier prevents the elevator from being exited prematurely. If Link has found the [[Korok]] in the Shrine of Resurrection, it will not be present during and after the elevator's descent. ===Areas=== {{Gallery List|Locations |BotW= Central Chamber, Electricity-Themed Wing, Lava-Themed Wing, Water-Themed Wing, Wind-Themed Wing }} ==Themes and Navigation== Upon entering the Final Trial, Link hears the voice of Monk Maz Koshia, who greets him.{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Monk Blue|Welcome, hero. You have overcome many trials to reach me. Now it is time to face the final trial.}}|Monk Maz Koshia|BotW}} He then informs Link that he will need a [[Map]], which can be obtained from the nearby [[Guidance Stone]].{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Monk Blue|This trial is a complex labyrinth. To start, you will need a map. You may obtain map information from the Guidance Stone.}}|Monk Maz Koshia|BotW}} The Guidance Stone authenticates the Sheikah Slate and grants Link a Map.{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Monk Blue|Sheikah Slate authenticated. Distilling map of Divine Beast.}}|Guidance Stone|BotW}} The Final Trial is comprised of a central chamber containing a series of mechanical gears. Four adjoining chambers are themed after each of the other [[Divine Beast]]s and four [[Champions]], with elemental themes of [[Wind]], [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], [[Fire]], and [[Electricity]]. The side-chambers contain gears and rotating walls and objects, but these will only move if the chambers are connected to the central mechanism via metallic or stone objects. Once the [[Dungeon]] Map has been obtained, the gears can be configured to rotate clockwise or counter-clockwise, which will have a cascading effect on the side-chambers if they have been connected to the central mechanism. Link can find a [[Treasure Chest]] containing a [[Gerudo Scimitar]] in the thunder chamber, one containing a [[Cobble Crusher]] in the fire chamber, one containing a [[Swallow Bow]] in the wind chamber, and one containing a [[Zora Spear]] in the water chamber. Each of these [[Weapon]]s are the Weapons required to craft each of the Champions' Weapons. In addition, Link can find a [[Diamond]] in a Treasure Chest, which is also required to craft a Champions' Weapon. Link can also find a [[Gerudo Shield]] in a Treasure Chest within the Dungeon, which can be crafted into [[Urbosa]]'s [[Daybreaker]] [[Shield]]. Lastly, Link can find a Treasure Chest containing five [[Bomb Arrow]]s. Each of the themed chambers contains a [[Terminal]] that Link can authenticate with his Sheikah Slate to unlock a single bolt on a large stone door at the rear of the central chamber.{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Monk Blue|Sheikah Slate authenticated.}}|Terminal|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Monk Blue|Deactivating one lock of the door.}}|Terminal|BotW}} The Terminal will then tell Link how many Terminals remain.{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Monk Blue|There are three terminals remaining.}}|Terminal|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Monk Blue|There are two terminals remaining.}}|Terminal|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Monk Blue|There is one terminal remaining.}}|Terminal|BotW}} This Dungeon is unique in that [[Enemy|Enemies]] will gradually appear in the central chamber as the Terminals are activated. Initially, only a sole [[Guardian Scout I]] is present, but three additional [[Guardian Scout I|Guardian Scouts I]] along with a [[Guardian Scout II]] appear after activating the first Terminal. After activating a second, a [[Guardian Turret]] appears in the center of the Dungeon. After the third Terminal is activated, two [[Guardian Skywatcher]]s will patrol the chamber. After the final Terminal lock has been deactivated, the last Terminal will tell Link that he can now access the deepest area of the Dungeon.{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Monk Blue|All terminal locks have been deactivated. You can now access the deepest area.}}|Terminal|BotW}} Once all four locks are disengaged, the door opens to reveal the [[Monk's Pedestal]] bearing Monk Maz Koshia. Monk Maz Koshia tells Link that he has proven to possess the power of a true hero and then begins to move.{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Monk Blue|You have proven to possess the power of a true hero.}}|Monk Maz Koshia|BotW}} Maz Koshia then stands up, offering Link the Final Trial{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Monk Blue|In the name of the Goddess Hylia... I offer this final trial!}}|Monk Maz Koshia|BotW}} The pair are [[Warping|Warped]] to a floating platform above the [[Great Plateau]]. Monk Maz Koshia then initiates a battle with Link as the [[Boss]] of the Dungeon.{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Monk Blue|Let us begin.}}|Monk Maz Koshia|BotW}} After defeating Monk Maz Koshia, he tells Link that he faced him with great courage and that he is a true hero.{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Monk Blue|You faced that challenge with great courage. You have erased all doubt from my mind. You are a true hero.}}|Monk Maz Koshia|BotW}} As a reward, Maz Koshia gives Link the [[Master Cycle Zero]] [[Rune]].{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Monk Blue|As such, you were destined to take hold of this ancient masterpiece...}}|Monk Maz Koshia|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Monk Blue|Sheikah Slate authenticated. Distilling rune...}}|Guidance Stone|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Monk Blue|Rune extracted.}}|Guidance Stone|BotW}} Calling the Master Cycle Zero a masterpiece of innovation for the one true hero, Maz Koshia wishes Link well and sends him back to the surface of the Great Plateau.{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Monk Blue|That which you have obtained... is a masterpiece of innovation, created for the one true hero. Hero of Hyrule... May the Goddess smile upon you.}}|Monk Maz Koshia|BotW}} ===Enemies=== {{Gallery List|Enemies |BotW= Guardian Scout I, Guardian Scout II {{Equipment|BotW|Guardian Spear+}}{{Equipment|BotW|Guardian Shield+}}, Guardian Skywatcher, Guardian Turret }} ==Trivia== * Each bolt in the rear of the Final Trial bears a letter in the [[Sheikah (Language)|Sheikah]] language, corresponding to the chamber's element: A (air),{{Cite|{{Script|Sheikah|A}}|N/A|BotW}} W (Water),{{Cite|{{Script|Sheikah|W}}|N/A|BotW}} F (Fire),{{Cite|{{Script|Sheikah|F}}|N/A|BotW}} and E (Electricity).{{Cite|{{Script|Sheikah|E}}|N/A|BotW}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:BotW Final Trial Lock.png|The lock that leads to the end of the Final Trial File:BotW Final Trial Boss Arena.png|The arena where Link fights Monk Maz Koshia File:BotW Master Cycle Zero.png|The Master Cycle Zero being presented to Link ==See Also== {{See Also| * Divine Beast * Dungeon * EX The Champions' Ballad }} {{Ref}} {{Dungeons|BotW}} {{Categories |Final Trial, Great Plateau |dungeons= BotW }}
